A1.rationale: Deterministic core vs bounded-agent table and phased approval gates show clear decoupled responsibilities and a scaling path; no component contracts or failure-domain diagrams yet.

A2.rationale: Cross-functional challenge table names each of the five requested agents, the alternative considered and why it was rejected or bounded instead.

A3.rationale: Named legislation, DPIA, segregation-of-duties and AI-risk controls are strong; no explicit attacker/threat model is stated.

A4.rationale: Document records the 30 Sept 2026 review finding 'no working evidence for implementation completeness'; only a planned non-production demonstrator exists.

A5.rationale: Pilot Evaluation table specifies cost, throughput and quality measures to capture, but nothing is yet instrumented or measured.

A6.rationale: Shadow-mode test design per capability is defined with stop criteria, but no evaluation harness exists and model choice is not yet justified.

A7.rationale: Agent boundaries (recommend/draft/reconcile/flag) and handoffs are well defined, but no autonomous behaviour has been demonstrated.

B1.rationale: Board Decision Narrative connects problem, stakes, options and recommendation; no live delivery evidence exists to assess argument landing with an audience.

B2.rationale: Document explicitly designs explanations for resident, staff, funder/regulator/Board audiences, but this is written register calibration, not observed live delivery.

B3.rationale: No demo exists yet; only a plan for a future non-production demonstrator is described.

B4.rationale: Sponsor discovery questions anticipate challenge areas, but there is no live Q&A evidence to assess composure under pressure.

B5.rationale: No timed delivery or rehearsal evidence exists in the repository.

B6.rationale: Extensive, cross-referenced, traceable documentation across two linked files with identifier schemes; still dense and reader-effort heavy in places, and no accompanying slide deck.

B7.rationale: Quantified illustrative economics and a sourced sector benchmark pack are interpreted carefully with caveats; no measured demo or live data storytelling yet.

C1.rationale: Stakeholders, constraints, quantified value at stake (GBP 312m scenario) and cost of inaction are explicit and interrogated rather than merely restated.

C2.rationale: Written role-agent challenge shows disagreement being recorded and addressed, but there is no live session evidence of real-time listening or disagreement navigation.

C3.rationale: Makes a clear recommendation (capped demonstrator, not full rollout), rejects premature five-agent autonomy, and surfaces unvalidated value claims unprompted.

D1.rationale: Substantial original synthesis (discovery brief, agent-request challenge) actionable by another architect; grounded mainly in sector research rather than direct company engagement evidence.

D2.rationale: Structured, cited, version-controlled with a documented review and revision history; not yet a standalone publishable piece separate from the BRD apparatus.

D3.rationale: No publication, filing or external dissemination path is recorded anywhere in the repository; produced for the rubric and internal programme use only.
